answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because zenith only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. In practice dawn is enforced by the ledger itself: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any comet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
